title: Switching Porfile via NSclient V3 doesn't work with APPS 3.0.2.3 and NS 15.02
symptom: After creating a new profile with new basal rates in Nightscout profile manager, switching to this profile in Nightscout is not effected on AAPS 3.0.2.3 app with NSClient V3 enabled unless switching to NSClient V1. Profile switch in NS at 7:02 was effected in AAPS directly after switching to NSClient V1 at 8:35.
cause: Entries made in NS Website require NS 1 API; the issue is known when using V3 API.
fix: Use NSClient V1 for profile switches made on the Nightscout website, or use AAPS Client for profile switches.
evidence_quote: But I read now, that entries made in NS Website require NS 1 so. The issue is known.
